Occurrences.Kwic: 與我喚沙彌來。曰：喚它來作甚麼？師曰：我有箇折脚鐺子，要它提上挈下。曰：恁麼則與和尚出隻手去也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Dharma Grove of the Tradition’s Mirror (宗鑑法林). Speaker: Yaoshan Weiyan.

Occurrences.Kwic: 暗昧。豈敢仰攀。如是則更不用篾束肚皮。却有箇折脚鐺子。與方來共守寂寥。若信得及。不在忉忉。或未諳
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1997.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄). Speaker: Yuanwu Keqin.

Occurrences.Kwic: 喚沙彌來。巖云：和尚喚他作什麼？山云：我有箇折脚鐺子，要伊提上挈下。巖云：與麼則與和尚出隻手去也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X64/X64n1260.xml). Outline Record of the Successive Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄). Speaker: Yaoshan Weiyan.

Occurrences.Kwic: 亦各出一隻手，且圖古風不墜。師云：瑞巖亦有箇折脚鐺子，傳來既久，直得脣囂耳脫，聲韻都無。有時颺在
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X68/X68n1318.xml). Continued Essentials from the Sayings of Ancient Worthies (續古尊宿語要). Speaker: Yaoshan Weiyan.

Occurrences.Kwic: 路。且別看佗古德道人，得意之後，茆茨石室，向折脚鐺子裏煑飯喫，三十二十年，名利不干懷，財寶不為念
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1557.xml). Essential Compendium of the United Lamp (聯燈會要). Speaker: the lamp-record compiler.

Occurrences.Kwic: 向雲巖道與我喚沙彌來巖云喚他作什麼師云我有箇折脚鐺子要伊提上挈下巖云與麼則某甲與和尚共出一隻手。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (P/P154/P154n1519.xml). Essential Compendium of the Zen School: Main and Continued Collections (Vols. 1–12) (宗門統要正續集(第1卷-第12卷)). Speaker: Yaoshan Weiyan.

Senses.Explanation: The expression denotes a cooking cauldron whose damaged leg makes it an emblem of rough, makeshift living. The retained records mention the vessel in residence descriptions, inherited exchanges, and concrete monastic imagery.
